name: 展開切替とその他操作のセクション見出し
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0021 展開切替とその他操作のセクション見出し.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE compact section heading row, original region20,338,350,36 normalized. Exact only Japanese text プライベート, Meiryo REGULAR40012px/16px,tracking0, left aligned. ORIGINAL controls disclosure glyph: a tiny shallow DOWNWARD chevron immediately after the label with compact8px logical gap, not the mock's distant UP caret. At far right preserve original horizontal three equally spaced dots for additional actions. Match source glyph shapes, optical size and alignment. Text secondary gray#6E6E6E and utility glyphs slate#526173, pure-white background, no card/fill/gradient/border/shadow or extra decoration. Keep compact350x36logical row, uniformly enlarged into readable wide1536x512 with restrained margins. No plus, extra label, phone or menu content. Preserve expanded/down chevron visible state from source.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: No accent warranted; hierarchy and chevron communicate disclosure. All text/icons remain coherent neutral/slate on white.
reviewNotes: 原版全体/crop/mock目視。mockの遠い上caretを原版に沿う隣接した下chevronへ修正。生成後にプライベート、下向きglyph、右3dots、白面、余分な装飾なしを確認。accent不要。font同一性/操作/native編集/所有者承認なし。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
